generator_sampling.distribution: the accepted constructible recipient-bundle law of the exact pure ordinal-blind function G(theta,E) bound by generator_manifest, source manifest, finite parameter law, acceptance predicate, and proposal limit
generator_sampling.sample: independent recipient-life/seed bundles using prospectively disjoint committed entropy slices under the registered entropy-source contract; each accepted bundle contains its own recipient-disjoint exactly matched donor sub-bundle; natural cross-draw semantic or entropy collisions are retained
generator_sampling.temporal_order: PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK fixes ordinal membership and safety-key templates before ENTROPY_ACQUISITION_RECEIPT; proposal/life realization and deterministic key resolution precede POPULATED_RUN_LOCK
generator_sampling.construction: all proposals and first-failure rejection receipts are retained; proposal exhaustion contributes zero joint release power and blocks populated run lock/run authority, and is neither redraw nor runtime missingness
generator_sampling.power_scope: every construction support row binds its typed construction evidence, per-life controls, exact mass, and applicable conditional complete-release power; the unconditional lower bound is the pointwise mass sum with failed and uncovered mass zero

clone_rule: All required arms for one sampled life are byte-identical pre-treatment clones and share the sealed common-random seed bundle at corresponding calls.

assays.controller: D1B_AUTHENTIC, D1B_ONE_SHOT, or D1B_OPEN_LOOP as prospectively assigned
varies_only: emitted public response bytes after the privileged route and sanitized projection

fixed: one-attempt READ slots then PREDICT then ACT

varies_only: root policy and every natural downstream consequence
fixed: one-attempt READ slots then PREDICT then ACT

d1a_corpus.source: all and only eligible direct closed public ACQUIRE outcomes before the sealed boundary
d1a_corpus.capacity: apply the run-locked target-blind capacity order after eligibility and before arm construction
d1a_corpus.typed_origin: corpus_origin_ref is a closed union: D1A_CORPUS_ORIGIN_RECEIPT for D1A or ROOT_SELECTION_RECEIPT for D1D; no D1A corpus pretends to have a D1D root policy
d1a_corpus.per_life_control: one D1A_CONTROL_SET_RECEIPT is keyed to each D1A sample ordinal and recipient life; D1A_CONTROL_SET_MANIFEST is the exact ordered membership-equal N-life collection and replaces every global singleton binding

binding_shuffle.algorithm: lexicographically first perfect derangement under the locked candidate-ID order
requires: every destination and donor row distinct
authentic and shuffled corpus hashes differ

wrong_life.one_to_one: within one independently generated recipient/donor bundle; donor artifacts never move or rematch across sampled lives, while coincident donor semantic identities from independent draws are retained
wrong_life.artifact_check: present and hash-valid before assignment; no runtime replacement
wrong_life.failure: CONSTRUCTION_FAIL for that prospectively sampled bundle, retained as a construction blocker with no redraw

path_oracle.sufficiency: all hidden world variants consistent with exactly the observation set imply one identical unique correct action
path_oracle.proper_subsets: all 2^L-2 nonempty proper subsets indexed by ascending bitmask and each insufficient
path_oracle.alternate_universe: all simple directed paths within the locked READ budget over the canonical eligible multigraph, enumerated by length then edge-ID tuple; exactly the registered path is sufficient
path_oracle.source_disjointness: ordered path edges bind distinct source_event_id values and distinct source_event preimage hashes; domain tags are not counted as disjoint sources
path_oracle.gate_key: path_template_id, edge_position, edge_id templates and sample ordinals are fixed in PRE_ENTROPY_DESIGN_LOCK; final generated identities are resolved deterministically after entropy and never content-selected
path_oracle.per_edge: every stable gate key binds typed RAW_SOURCE_EVENT, CUT_CONSTRUCTION, TWIN_CONSTRUCTION, SHAM_CONSTRUCTION, PARITY_PROOF, ORACLE_EVALUATION, and SOURCE_DISJOINTNESS_PROOF objects
path_oracle.off_path: a valid non-target READ with zero assigned-target matches emits OFF_PATH_AUTHENTIC_PASS_THROUGH using the common provider response; one target match applies the intervention; multiple matches or zero matches for the assigned target key is RUN_INVALID; only INTERVENTION_EMISSION_RECEIPT.emitted_public_bytes may reach public_view.last_read and later THINK

overlap.use: construction and descriptive reporting only; aggregate counts are pure derivatives of ordered typed per-unit OVERLAP_MEMBERSHIP_ENTRY objects and canonical comparison keys
overlap.release_binding: overlap_manifest_hash and construction_scope_receipt_hash are mandatory in every release/export receipt
